div.div: حُوَاطَةٌ An enclosure (حَظِيرَة) made for wheat: (S, K:) or it signifies a thing which one soon quits, or relinquishes, or from which one soon abstains; and so ↓ حُوَاطٌ , as occurring [accord. to one relation] in a verse cited voce عُرْسٌ. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
